hunting_rotation.policy: Newest eight eligible 2026+ hunting and equestrian stories outside lead, side cards and Updates, ordered by original publication date without a per-topic quota; refresh on every publication. Superseded news stays in the archive.

chronological_placement_note: Nayef cancelled the special placement of Adonis’s Sayd Returns editorial on 6 October 2026. Keep its original 8 September 2026 publication date and ordinary chronological position in its category and archive; no homepage pin or special exclusion from Updates.

science_image_gate.explanation: Science section may be rendered only once each featured image has a local verified copy and attribution metadata

editorial_reference_policy: Hunting Laws and Bird Encyclopedia articles appear in their own category only, never headline cards, Updates or news ticker.
